metodosActivacion.intro: In addition to the main alert button, you can trigger an alert using these alternative methods. Learn about them to react faster when you need to.
metodosActivacion.nota: More quick activation methods will be added soon. This section will update automatically once they're available.
metodosActivacion.agitar_desc: Trigger an emergency alert by shaking your phone firmly, without needing to open the app or unlock the screen.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso1: Turn on this feature from Settings > Activation methods > Enable
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso2: Shake the phone quickly and firmly, several times in a row.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso3: The system detects the sudden movement and triggers the alert automatically.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso4: You'll feel a vibration while the alert is being sent
metodosActivacion.popup_titulo: Pop-up notification on the lock screen
metodosActivacion.popup_desc: A pop-up notification appears over the lock screen with a shortcut button to send the alert without unlocking your phone.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso1: Grant permission to show notifications over other apps.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso2: When your phone is locked, the notification will appear in the foreground.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso3: Tap the alert button inside the notification to trigger it immediately
metodosActivacion.popup_paso4: You don't need to enter your password or unlock your phone

politicaPrivacidad.item1_desc: The app may collect information such as real-time location, contact details, and access to the camera and microphone, necessary for the safety features to work.
politicaPrivacidad.item2_desc: The information collected is used exclusively to send emergency alerts, share location with selected contacts, and generate evidence in risky situations.
politicaPrivacidad.item3_desc: Information will only be shared with emergency contacts previously set up by the user or when necessary to comply with legal obligations.
politicaPrivacidad.item4_desc: Data may be stored locally on the device or on secure servers, depending on the feature used.
politicaPrivacidad.item5_desc: Security measures are implemented to protect user information; however, absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
politicaPrivacidad.item6_desc: Users can manage, modify or delete their personal information from the app or by requesting it through the contact channels.
politicaPrivacidad.item7_desc: The app requests permissions such as location, camera, microphone and contacts solely for functions related to user safety.
politicaPrivacidad.item8_desc: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Changes will be notified within the app.
politicaPrivacidad.item9_desc: For privacy-related questions, users can reach out through the official channels available in the app.

politicaTerminos.item1_desc: By downloading, installing or using the Alerta Mujer app, the user agrees to comply with these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you should refrain from using the app.
politicaTerminos.item2_desc: Alerta Mujer is a mobile app designed to improve personal safety through sending emergency alerts, sharing real-time location, notifying emergency contacts, and recording audio and/or video in risky situations. The app is intended as support and does not replace official emergency services.
politicaTerminos.item3_desc: Users agree to use the app only for legitimate personal safety purposes, not to generate false or malicious alerts, not to use the app to harass, threaten or harm others, and to provide truthful information when registering. Misuse may result in suspension or removal of access.
politicaTerminos.item4_desc: Users acknowledge they are responsible for their use of the app, must correctly set up their emergency contacts, and must keep their device charged and connected for it to work properly.
politicaTerminos.item5_desc: Alerta Mujer does not guarantee an immediate response from emergency contacts, does not ensure continuous service availability, and is not liable for damages arising from the use or inability to use the app.
politicaTerminos.item6_desc: The app may request access to real-time location, the camera, the microphone and the device's contacts. These permissions are used exclusively for the safety features to work.
politicaTerminos.item7_desc: The use of personal information is governed by the Privacy Policy. By using the app, the user agrees to the processing of their data in accordance with that policy.
politicaTerminos.item8_desc: Audio and/or video recordings generated may be stored locally or on secure servers, are the user's responsibility, and may be used as evidence in legal situations.
politicaTerminos.item9_desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be notified within the app.
politicaTerminos.item10_desc: We may suspend or cancel access to the app in case of misuse, violation of these terms, or suspicious or fraudulent activity.
politicaTerminos.item11_desc: These terms are governed by the laws in force in the country where the app operates.
politicaTerminos.item12_desc: For questions or support, users can reach out through the official channels available within the app.
